en-US.description: Photo library and raw development; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Lightroom, rebuilt in pure Rust
en-US.longDescription:
Photo library and raw development; an open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Lightroom, rebuilt in pure Rust.
Your photos. Your pixels. Your machine. Native on macOS, Windows and Linux. In the browser via WebAssembly. Drivable end to end by AI agents over MCP.
LightCraft is a complete darkroom in a single native app. Every adjustment is non-destructive, so your originals are never touched. Every slider renders through a scene-referred, wide-gamut, 32-bit float pipeline: highlights roll off like film, shadows open up without halos, and colour stays clean from capture to export.
Pure Rust, no C. Our own RAW decoders (DNG, Canon CR2, Sony ARW, Nikon NEF, Fujifilm RAF incl. X-Trans, Panasonic RW2, Pentax PEF, Olympus ORF), our own colour science, our own pipeline. JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, PSD composites and JPEG XL open today.
en-US.name: LightCraft
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- security(raw): shared header-scan budget for tagged previews, tile-sized lossy JPEG budget, bound deflate tile padding by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3695
- security: O(width) box-blur priming, case-insensitive download names, stats walk skips directory links by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3729
- security(engine): read user-named files through the opened regular file under a byte cap by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/3703
- Release: LightCraft v0.21.0 on main by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/4153
- security: mask.exportEffects refuses originals and sidecars, writes atomically by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/4125
- CI: nightly release dry run by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/4154
- Use craft-tiff from craft-libs for TIFF/IFD by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/4088
- Fix Flatpak updates and bump to 0.21.1 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/pull/4151
Full Changelog: https://github.com/storytold/lightcraft/compare/v0.21.0...v0.21.1

zh-CN.description: 照片库与 RAW 显影；以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Lightroom 净室重实现
zh-CN.longDescription:
照片库与 RAW 显影；一个以纯 Rust 全新重写的开源 Adobe Lightroom 净室重实现。
你的照片。你的像素。你的机器。macOS、Windows 和 Linux 原生应用，通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中使用，并可由 AI 智能体通过 MCP 端到端驱动。
LightCraft 是一个本地应用中的完整暗房。每项调整都是非破坏性的，原图永不改动。每个滑块都通过场景参照、宽色域、32 位浮点管线渲染：高光如胶片般柔顺滚降，阴影无光晕地展开，色彩从拍摄到导出始终纯净。
纯 Rust，无 C 代码。自研 RAW 解码器（DNG、佳能 CR2、索尼 ARW、尼康 NEF、富士 RAF 含 X-Trans、松下 RW2、宾得 PEF、奥林巴斯 ORF）、自研色彩科学、自研管线。JPEG、PNG、TIFF、WebP、PSD 合成及 JPEG XL 均可打开。
